name: claude-skills
description: Franck Djiongo's Claude Code skills library, distributed as installable plugins.

plugins.name: design-forge
plugins.description: UX/UI Quality Analyst and Design Brief Architect: AUDIT, TEST, and BRIEF modes with a brief-to-build-to-verify pipeline. Bundles a router skill and three specialist sub-agents.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: The complete design pipeline as one plugin: brand identity (brand-forge), premium production-grade websites and app UIs with a real-browser visual QA loop (ship-polished-ui), and polished documentary artifacts — slides, plans, reports, dashboards (design-elevation) — plus a visual-qa-inspector sub-agent for fresh-context browser verification.
